The '''Great Hall''' was a vast chamber located on the first level of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. A place of gathering for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], the hall was lined with many tiers of balconies where [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knights]] could be seated. Used for various purposes, the Hall served as the location of the [[Jedi funeral/Legends|funerals]] of great Jedi Masters.<ref name="TCSWE" /> Directly beyond the main entrance hall, the Great Hall led to the [[Sacred spire/Legends|sacred spire]] at the center of the structure.<ref name="FOTJOT" />

==History==
[[File:Jedi_Temple_Great_Hall.png|left|thumb|The Great Hall during the Sacking of Coruscant|300x300px]]
The Great Hall of the Jedi Temple was one of the many vast chambers located on the first level of the Temple. Erected circa [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]] by the [[Four Masters/Legends|Four Masters]],<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> the Hall would stand until [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline 1" /> when the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] [[Sacking of Coruscant|ransacked]] [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] and destroyed part of it during their attack on the Temple.<ref name="Deceived trailer">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/deceived-cinematic-trailer|text=Deceived Cinematic Trailer|int=Deceived}}</ref>

===Clone Wars===
[[File:Jedi Purge.png|thumb|The Great Hall during Operation: Knightfall|left|400x400px]]
Having later been rebuilt, the Great Hall would exist until the Temple was again destroyed at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], in his alter ego as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], ordered the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] to [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|eliminate]] the Jedi, and take the Temple on behalf of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Marching into the Temple under the leadership of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] destroyed the Great Hall as they slaughtered the Jedi that occupied the Temple. Afterwards Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] [[Infiltration of the Jedi Temple/Legends|infiltrated]] the Temple and saw multiple dead [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Younglings]] lying in the Great Hall.<ref name="ROTS" />

=== Later years ===
The Great Hall would lie in silence as the Empire ruled the galaxy for the next few decades. Eventually, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] was able to drive the Empire from Coruscant and the [[New Jedi order|New Jedi Order]], under the leadership of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], reinhabited the Temple for a brief period.<ref name="BRS">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]''</ref> However, the Temple would not survive the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], being lost during the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]] to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref> While the old Temple was lost, the substructure of the Temple remained. Reclaiming Coruscant and driving the Yuuzhan Vong offworld, the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cal Omas]] donated a [[New Jedi Temple|new Temple]] to the Order for their efforts during the War. Built by the [[Reconstruction Authority]] using schematics saved from the lost [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Temple Archives]], the Temple was rebuilt as it had stood for several millennia, despite having a new outer shell.<ref name="Dark Nest I: The Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

As the Jedi Order flourished, the Great Hall served the Order as it always had. In the year [[44 ABY]], Jedi Knight [[Valin Horn]] was showing signs of a [[Force psychosis|mysterious disease]] causing him to think that everyone he met was a replacement of the real individual. Having been kept in the Temple's [[Halls of Healing]], Horn managed to escape, fleeing into Galactic City. In an attempt to avoid media coverage, Grand Master Skywalker assembled all available Knights and Masters to the Great Hall. Here, Skywalker and [[Jedi healer/Legends|Chief Healer]] [[Cilghal]] organized search parties to located and detain Horn. While the Jedi managed to capture Horn, the Galactic Alliance intervened and declared that he would be treated in an Alliance medical hospital.<ref name="FOTJOT" />

Later that year, Chief Of State [[Natasi Daala]] ordered that Grand Master Skywalker be exiled from the Order, Interim Grand Master [[Kenth Hamner]] assembled the entire Jedi presence on Coruscant, including long time friends of the founder of the Order, to say farewell to him as he left on his ten year ban from the Order. Immediately after, Interim Master Hamner took advantage of his new position to install new activities that he felt necessary to bring the Order into line. He arranged for morning briefings to be held in the Hall directly after breakfast. Though he admitted addressing the Order through their individual [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] may have been more efficient, he preferred to see everyone's reactions to his news. In one of his addresses he restated that all Jedi were to comply with the [[Galactic Alliance Senate|Senate]]-appointed [[Jedi supervisor]]s and not to evade them. After that specific address, Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] evaded her supervisor, [[Dab Hantaq]], by slipping behind a column and down a back stair, descending two stories to a dark, seldom used conference room. Here, she met Head of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Jagged Fel]] and discussed the possibility of starting a schismatic Jedi school in the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]].<ref name="FOTJOT" />

When a report on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] reported the escape of rogue Jedi [[Seff Hellin]] and Valin Horn from the [[Armand Isard Correctional Facility]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Oric Harfard]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] marched into the Temple and demanded that Master Hamner confess to having a part in the escape. Heading to the [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]] in the Great Hall, Hamner led the Captain past a group of gathered Jedi consisting of Jedi Solo, [[Kolir Hu'lya|Hu'lya]] and Master [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]]. Hamner and Harfard left the chamber as they shot through the Temple to Hamner's quarters.<ref name="FOTJOT" />

After Jedi left their Temple on [[Mission to Upekzar|mission]] to find and destroy [[Abeloth]] and [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] became temporary occupants of the Jedi Temple. [[Grand Lord]] [[Darish Vol]] once walked Great Hall with [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Ivaar Workan]] praising him for his difficult work to infiltrate Sith on [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] capital city [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and preparation for Sith to rule [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], shortly after he was killed by Abeloth disguised as senator "Rokari Kem".<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>

==Layout==
The Great Hall was a four-story tall chamber situated directly beyond the Temple Main Entrance at the [[Processional Way/Legends|Processional Way]].<ref name="SWCL" /> A raised way lined with pillars extended throughout the the middle of the hall. During the time of the Sacking of Coruscant, the way was lined with many statues of hooded figures,<ref name="Deceived trailer" /> but at the time at the end of the Clone Wars, significantly less statues remained in the Hall, including one of a [[Human/Legends|human]] figure with a [[Book/Legends|book]] and a ball permanently above her stretched hand.<ref name="ROTS" /> A large meeting chamber with many tiers and balconies, seats would be brought in for formal gatherings and [[Jedi Convocation|conclaves]]. Between many of the pillars lining the hall were passages and stairways leading to small chambers near the Hall. In addition, several banks of [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]] led into the depths of the Temple, ensuring that the Great Hall could be reached from any level of the complex. Off one of the tiers was a small lecture hall where [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] came for group learning sessions. The lecture room was converted to a base of operations for the Senate appointed a supervisor that was to monitor each Jedi's daily actions.<ref name="FOTJOT" />
